source.email: Max DiPlotti — Budget vs Actual - September 2026 (Oct 16 2026)

notes: Source: LT_BvA_Sep2026.xlsx from Max DiPlotti email 'Budget vs Actual - September 2026' (Oct 16 2026).
Authoritative period aggregates (september, q3, ytd, quarters, full_year_budget) are from the 'P&L' sheet.
Workbook dollar row labeled 'Gross Margin' is mapped to gross_profit; 'Gross Margin %' to gross_margin (decimal).
EBITDA / EBITDA % are as reported. No 'adjusted EBITDA' line exists on this workbook.
YTD actual = P&L AO (header 'Full Year'/'Actual'); AN (Q4 actual)=0 so AO = Q1+Q2+Q3 through Sep 2026.
YTD budget = P&L AT = AP(Q1 bud)+AQ(Q2 bud)+AR(Q3 bud). Do not use AR alone as 9-month budget: AR row-6 header says '9 QTD' but values equal Q3-only budget (same as AF).
Full-year budget = P&L AZ (row 6 'Full Year'). Row 7 on AZ oddly says 'Q1 2026 Budget'; values (~$30.66M revenue) treated as FY 2026 budget.
Monthly Jul–Sep from P&L; Jan–Mar from 'Q1 2026'; Apr–Jun from 'Q2 2026'.

RECONCILIATION BREAK: Q2 sheet Total OpEx / EBITDA do not match P&L Q2 column. P&L AL63 OpEx $3,120,836.31 vs Q2 sheet AL62 $3,770,826.32 (diff −$649,990). Entire gap is G&A Staff: P&L AL53 $1,392,155.07 vs Q2 AL52 $2,042,155.07 (exact −$650,000). June G&A Staff on Q2 sheet Z52=$1,179,192.60 looks like the inflated month. Use quarters.q2 from P&L for OpEx/EBITDA; treat Apr–Jun monthly OpEx/EBITDA/ga_staff as Q2-sheet snapshots that are stale vs the Sep P&L package. Revenue and gross profit DO reconcile across sheets.
Q1 sheet vs P&L Q1: revenue/GP match; EBITDA differs by ~$31 (P&L AK65 $1,095,143.44 vs Q1 AK65 $1,095,174.46) — immaterial, likely cache/rounding.

Revenue taxonomy varies by sheet: Q1 has nvv + loan_sales_mres, omits fund_slb_acquisition_carried_interest and other_revenue_mp; Q2/P&L include fund_slb_acquisition_carried_interest; P&L adds other_revenue_mp. Absent lines are null.
Cost of Sales = Direct Staff + Other Direct + Capital Markets Direct only (no vendor/appraiser pass-through). Prior AUDIT.md inferred Marketplace may be net of vendor cost; not re-verified here.
Other Income/Expenses (sublease, interest, other inc/exp, D&A, due diligence) are below EBITDA; included on september/q3/ytd from P&L only.
Reforecast tabs inspected, not loaded. Budget scenario label on monthly P&L cols is 'Q3 2026 Budget'.
units: money USD; margins decimal; variance=actual-budget; variance_pct=(actual-budget)/budget.
